description: Reviewed UK local-area support-floor exclusions and signed families that bind despite those floors. Every entry carries measured evidence and an in-force adjudication. The exclusions are gate-only (microcosm#1301): an entry, keyed local_authority/<code> or constituency/<code> and optionally scoped by release_lines, excuses its area at the uk_local_area_support gate and defers none of its cells, so no target compilation reads this file. The Isles of Scilly and City of London cell deferrals (microcosm#762 A14) and the families bound despite the floor are constants of tools/generate_uk_local_target_references.py, lockstep-tested against this file. Reasons name the floors an area misses, never its figures.

local_authority/E06000053.reason: Reviewed exclusion of the local-authority support floor for Isles of Scilly (E06000053): population-proportional ladder assignment gives the area too few positive-weight rows, at the ruled K=15 and at every smaller K measured, to meet the 50-row floor, and its effective sample size on the R17 release candidate misses the ESS-50 floor (microcosm#761 receipts section R1, identical on spine-i and spine-k), so the 50-row / ESS-50 / 50-source floor is unreachable by clone count. The area stays in the solve with its measured support and is flagged support_below_floor in the build's area-support table (the candidate manifest's area_support_summary) and named in the release manifest's area_support block; consumers must treat its estimates as unsupported. Re-measured on every candidate; a passing area retires this entry (a stale exclusion fails the gate). Re-worded in microcosm#1278: where the flag is recorded (2026-10-14), and without per-area support figures (2026-10-15). Per microcosm#762 A14 the authority's own local-authority cells are signed-deferred (`local_authority_support_floor_excluded`).

local_authority/E09000001.reason: Reviewed exclusion of the local-authority support floor for City of London (E09000001): population-proportional ladder assignment gives the area enough positive-weight rows at the ruled K=15 to clear the 50-row floor, but its effective sample size on the R17 release candidate misses the ESS-50 floor (microcosm#761 receipts section R1, identical on spine-i and spine-k). This receipt does not establish whether the separate 50-source floor passes or how further cloning would affect ESS. The area stays in the solve with its measured support and is flagged support_below_floor in the build's area-support table (the candidate manifest's area_support_summary) and named in the release manifest's area_support block; consumers must treat its estimates as unsupported. Re-measured on every candidate; a passing area retires this entry (a stale exclusion fails the gate). Re-worded in microcosm#1278: where the flag is recorded (2026-10-14), and without per-area support figures (2026-10-15). Per microcosm#762 A14 the authority's own local-authority cells are signed-deferred (`local_authority_support_floor_excluded`).

local_authority/S12000023.reason: Reviewed gate-only exclusion of the local-authority support floor for Orkney Islands (S12000023), signed before the first build of the microcosm#1301 local release: the authority missed the floor on the atomic-support builds at K=25 with 60,000 and 100,000 households and on the K=15 build with 95,000 households. Gate-only (microcosm#1301): its cells stay bound and none is deferred, so the entry does not change the solve. The area is flagged support_below_floor in the build's area-support table (the candidate manifest's area_support_summary) and named in the release manifest's area_support block; consumers must treat its estimates as unsupported. Scoped to the local line. Re-measured on every candidate; a passing area retires this entry (a stale exclusion fails the gate).
local_authority/S12000023.adjudication: microcosm#1301 plan approved by María on 2026-10-16: Orkney and Shetland are pre-signed gate-only before the first build
